name: allocations-api

dependencies.name: crm-service
dependencies.description: Searches CRM opportunities so a customer engagement can be raised from one, and reads the chosen opportunity's name and customer.

description: The single backend for the allocations product; this run covers customer engagements. It owns engagement records (raise from a CRM opportunity, pick one of five types, edit while open, list the caller's own, complete, cancel), enforces the 5-day past-date limit, and proxies CRM opportunity search so the browser never holds CRM credentials. Serves HTTP behind the gateway and verifies its signed assertion. It does not allocate consultants, approve engagements or send notifications in this run.
